title: Prop gate eval task
description: One gate task: an isolated workspace, a sequence of interactive turns (goals and commands), the scripted provider responses, and the expected observable outcome. A legacy task may give a single `goal` instead of `turns`.

turns.description: Ordered inputs typed into the interactive session (C6).

workspace.description: Initial files, relative to the workspace root, materialized before the session.

config.description: Partial configuration, deep-merged over the gate defaults.

host_shell.description: Host shell the task's run_command strings assume (C3). A task marked posix is skipped on platforms without a POSIX host shell (Windows); those paths are unit-tested instead.

status.description: Status of the last goal run (legacy single-goal tasks).

files.description: Expected final contents for the listed paths; other paths are ignored.

tools.description: Expected ordered tool-call names, across the whole session.

observations.description: Expected substrings of the tool observations, in call order: entry i must appear in the i-th observation. Shorter than the tool-call log means only the prefix is checked.

runs.description: Expected result of each goal run, in order.

plan.description: Expected final plan item texts, in order.

sessionPersisted.description: Whether a session file exists and reloads with the same id and transcript length.
